title: Sister Supernova
prompt: dance pop in the style of the band big sis
description: Sweeping supersaw chords in C minor build from a shimmering hi-hat intro through a driving four-on-the-floor chorus with punchy claps and a stabbing sawtooth bassline. A melodic supersaw riff enters over the main drop, climbing and reversing with each repeat, before the track dissolves back into drifting pads.
